newsitem.title: UK: Four Friday Brent dates all kept voluntarily.
newsitem.headline: Four Friday Brent dates all kept voluntarily.

text.p: All four Brent cargoes nominated loading dates on Friday were kept voluntarily ahead of the five o'clock deadline, oil traders said.
BP kept a May 10-12 and a May 12-14 cargo. Shell's Stasco kept a May 11-13 loader and Vitol kept a May 12-14 cargo, the traders said.
Brent cargoes are traded on a paper, or forward market until the 1700 London time deadline on the nearest trading day 15 days before their assigned loading date.
